name: RetrieveDataTableColumnIntoList
label: Retrieve Data Table Column Into List
description: Extracts data from a specified column of a data table into a list. The column can be identified by name or index.

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table containing the column to convert into a list.

fields.name: ColumnNameOrIndex
fields.label: Column Name or Index
fields.description: Specifies which column to extract by name (if defined) or index (zero-based).

fields.name: ColumnAsList
fields.label: Column as List
fields.description: Returns the contents of the selected column as a list of strings.
